caption: Pull request #123
text: Pull request one two three. Say here, in one sentence, what went wrong. Let me show you.

caption: Setting the scene
text: Name what you are doing before you do it, so the action confirms the words.

caption: The ordinary step that breaks
text: Describe the step as ordinary. The viewer has to believe they would have done the same.

caption: The failure
text: Say what just broke, and what it costs. This is the pain the video exists to show.

caption: The same steps, with the fix
text: The same steps, with the fix applied.

caption: What happens instead
text: Say what happens now in its place, and why that is better.

caption: What now exists
text: Name the thing rather than the change. A viewer arriving here should be able to say what now exists.

text: This has been PRESENTER NAME. Thanks for watching, and I will see you on the next one.
